job.name: ig26_cover
job.person_note: The SAME woman as in the attached photo: same face, hair colour and features; do not change her face shape.
job.style: A finished, eye-catching vertical Instagram Reels COVER, photorealistic, bright and playful. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian typography is REQUIRED. No logos, no watermarks, no UI elements.
job.style_qa: обложка: та же женщина-психолог, что на референсе, в зелёном кресле с хитрым прищуром; сверху крупно жёлтым «Ж . . . Ь» и ниже «КАКОЕ СЛОВО ВИДИШЬ ТЫ?» без ошибок, других слов нет
job.meaning: обложка Reels «Ж...Ь — какое слово видишь ты?»
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16. The psychologist from the reference sits in her bottle-green velvet armchair in the LOWER half of the frame, with a sly knowing squint and one eyebrow raised, pointing up at the text. Above her, centred: huge bold bright-yellow letters «Ж . . . Ь» (letter Ж, three dots, letter Ь) with a thin dark outline, and under it a white bold title in two lines «КАКОЕ СЛОВО» «ВИДИШЬ ТЫ?» with a soft dark shadow. All text must sit between 22% and 62% of the image height. Bright home living room background, slightly blurred.
